skill2: Activates when HP falls below 20%. Affects self. Effect varies according to the number of uses. Perseverance: Only one effect is triggered at a time. Once: Max HP ▲ 91% for 3 sec. Activates once per battle. Twice: Max HP ▲ 69.84% for 3 sec. Activates once per battle. Three Times: Max HP ▲ 51.09% for 3 sec. Activates once per battle.
burst: Recovers 36.14% of attack damage as HP for 10 sec.
Attract: Taunts all enemies for 10 sec.
DEF ▲ 14.85% of the skill user's DEF for 10 sec.

caveats: ⚑ S1 line 1 'DEF ▲3.51% per 1% HP lost' is HP-state-dependent. The v1 boss deals no damage, so HP loss is 0 and the true in-sim value is 0%. Authored at 17.55% (a nominal 5%-HP-lost stand-in) purely for kit completeness; defPct is inert in v1 so this moves no damage either way. Do NOT read 17.55 as a measured magnitude.

⚑ S1 line 2 trigger: 'landing 5 normal attack(s) while weapon is changed' encoded as hitCount:5 + swapGate:'swapped'. The swap is burst-only (10s), so the rider only fires inside the burst window — its total contribution is entirely governed by the ⚑ swap shot economy below.

⚑ Burst weapon-swap shot economy is kit-silent: no pullsPerSec, no maxAmmo, no maxShots authored, so the engine reuses the base AR cadence with unlimitedAmmo for the 10s window. This is the optimistic default per the priors and is the single largest unmeasured lever in this override.

⚑ S1 line 3 'Fervor: Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼20 sec continuously' — 'when Raptures appear' = battle start; encoded as a one-shot 20s CDR. Whether the engine should instead model Fervor as a persistent CD-reduction state (and whether it re-applies) is unresolved.

⚑ Fervor STATUS GATE NOT MODELED: S2's team-wide 7.48s CDR is kit-gated on 'while in Fervor status'. Fervor is granted by S1 at battle start with no stated expiry, so the gate is treated as permanently satisfied and the block fires on EVERY Full Burst. If Fervor is actually consumed or windowed, this OVER-CREDITS team burst-CDR for the whole fight — highest-leverage line to verify.
The S2 taunt block is authored with an empty effects array to keep the lastBullet trigger auditable; taunt/aggro has no engine primitive.
Burst 'ATK ▲42.57% of the skill user's ATK' → casterAtkPct (flat add from Moran's own ATK), not atkPct. Moran is a Defender with no ATK-scaling identity, so this is a real but modest team buff.
'Damage Taken ▼35.14%' is a DEFENSIVE ally buff (incoming damage), NOT the offensive damageTakenPct boss debuff — deliberately unmodeled, not mapped to damageTakenPct.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Moran is an AR/Electric/Defender/Burst I taunt-tank whose offensive footprint is almost entirely (a) the team ATK/burst-CDR support in her burst and S2, and (b) a 10s weapon-swap window at 14.7%/shot carrying a 47.18% every-5-hits rider. Her S1 DEF scaler and the entire Perseverance/taunt/lifesteal/damage-taken-down half of the kit are survivability-only and inert against the v1 immortal-boss scope. The two load-bearing unknowns are the swap shot economy and whether Fervor status persists all fight.

flags.estimate: Omitted — engine falls back to base AR cadence for the full 10s with unlimitedAmmo; roughly 10s × base AR pulls/sec swapped shots at 14.7% each.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #3: weapon-swap shot economy is kit-silent. The prose gives only damage% and duration — no rate of fire, no magazine, no shot cap for the swapped weapon. Priors say estimate optimistically, so the full-uptime unlimited-ammo read is the default. This also fully determines how many times the S1 hitCount:5 rider (47.18%) fires, so an error here compounds across two lines.
flags.recipe: Record a solo Moran fight; count swapped-weapon shots in the 10s burst window from the popup stream (ammo counter is uninformative under unlimited ammo). Divide by 10 for effective pulls/sec and set weaponSwap.pullsPerSec; count 47.18% rider popups and check it equals floor(shots/5).

flags.estimate: 17.55 (= 3.51 × 5, a nominal 5%-HP-lost stand-in). TRUE in-sim value is 0.
flags.reasoning: The magnitude is a function of live HP loss, which the v1 immortal-boss scope pins at 0%. Any non-zero number is a placeholder. defPct is documented inert in v1, so this is damage-neutral either way — but the number must not be mistaken for a measurement. Per the priors, DEF lines are not skippable (future consumer/scaler), so the block stays.
flags.recipe: Only becomes meaningful if/when the sim models incoming boss damage and an HP pool. At that point drive value from live (100 − hpPct) × 3.51 rather than a constant; until then treat as 0 and do not tune against it.

flags.field: override.skill2[1] (Fervor status gate on the 7.48s team burstCdr)
flags.estimate: Gate treated as ALWAYS SATISFIED — the block fires on every Full Burst for the whole fight.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #2-adjacent (kit-silent condition). S1 grants Fervor 'when Raptures appear' (battle start) 'continuously', with no stated expiry or consumption. There is no engine primitive for a self-held named status (targetStatus is enemy-only), so the gate cannot be expressed. If Fervor is in fact consumed by the S1 CDR or windowed, this over-credits team burst-CDR on every rotation — the highest-leverage error in this override, since burst-CDR compounds into rotation count.
flags.recipe: Record a multi-rotation fight with Moran and a fixed team; measure the actual burst-gauge/cooldown timeline across rotations 1→2→3. If the 7.48s reduction is present on every Full Burst, the gate is correctly always-on; if it appears only on the first, re-key the block to a once-per-battle form.

flags.reasoning: 'Activates when Raptures appear' has no recurring shape, and 'continuously' reads as the Fervor STATE being continuous rather than the CDR re-applying. But burstCdr has no 'continuous' form, so a one-shot at t=0 is the faithful available encoding. Alternative reading — a permanent 20s shortening of every Moran burst cycle — would be materially stronger over a long fight.
flags.recipe: Measure Moran's own burst cooldown on rotation 1 vs rotation 2. If rotation 2's cooldown is also 20s short of her 40s base, the effect is persistent and needs a per-cycle encoding, not oncePerBattle.

flags.estimate: Rider fires every 5th normal-attack hit, but only during the 10s burst swap window.
flags.reasoning: 'while weapon is changed' is a swap-state gate, and the only weapon change in this kit is her own burst. hitCount counts ROUNDS not pulls (hitsPerShot is 1 for this AR, so rounds == pulls here — no ambiguity). Whether the 5-hit counter persists across swap windows or resets at each swap is kit-silent; the engine's cumulative counter means leftover progress carries into the next burst, which slightly front-loads later windows.
flags.recipe: Count 47.18% popups within one 10s swap window and compare against floor(swappedShots/5); a mismatch of exactly the carry-over amount confirms cumulative counting.
